ZMB.note: Only says Zambia is considering policy and legal frameworks; no draft rule, rule in force or authority on AI harms stated.
No government body's use of AI in administration is stated.
Only a mining anecdote and a planned AI weather early-warning system; no public sector AI tool under way or in service.

facts.fact: Permanent Secretary Brilliant Habeenzu of the Ministry of Technology and Science said Zambia's existing AI strategy is approaching the end of its term.

ZMB.note: An AI-enabled data centre is only a ministry priority being explored with China and Huawei; no builder, funder or site agreed.
Existing Chinese-supported data centres are mentioned as storage-oriented, with no statement that any rents capacity to others.
Nothing on rural access programmes or rural-urban use.
No data centre for hire or its owner is named.
